timeline.text: Welcome to Feeling Like You're Always the One Who Reaches Out. I’ll guide you through each tapping point. At every point, you’ll hear a short phrase. Repeat it aloud, or quietly inside your head. Let’s begin.

timeline.ins: Begin tapping on the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I always seem to be the one who reaches out.

timeline.ins: Now tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I keep noticing who initiates and who doesn’t.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I’m wondering if they would reach out at all.

timeline.ins: Now tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I feel hurt by the imbalance.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body feels tired of carrying the effort.

timeline.ins: Now tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I want to matter to them the way they matter to me.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: Part of me is afraid to stop and see what happens.

timeline.ins: Now tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can admit that this feels lonely.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: This pattern is starting to wear on me.

timeline.text: Take one easy breath. Notice whether anything has shifted, even slightly. If nothing has changed yet, that’s completely okay. Keep breathing, and we’ll continue.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I can notice this pattern without deciding I’m unwanted.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: People show love in different ways and paces.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I can ask for more without assuming the worst.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I don’t have to keep score to know how I feel.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can release the pressure of always initiating.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I’m allowed to take a step back and rest.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: My effort has value, even if it goes unmatched sometimes.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can be honest about what I need from this relationship.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: I can let myself see clearly what’s really here.

timeline.text: Take another slow breath. Notice what feels different now. You don’t need the feeling to disappear. See if there’s simply a little less pressure, or a little more choice in how you meet this moment.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I’m worthy of being reached for, not just reaching.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I trust myself to notice what relationships give back.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I can choose where to put my effort.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can value connection without over-giving.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can feel steady either way.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I can speak up about what I need.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I deserve relationships that reach back.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I’m allowed to protect my own energy.

timeline.ins: Finish under your arm.
timeline.say: I’m ready to see this clearly.

timeline.text: Let your hands rest, and take one full breath. Notice how you feel now, without needing to judge it. Thank you for taking this time for yourself. Carry this steadiness with you as you continue.
